questions.q: What did the cold morning and the white vapour from the marsh tell Jim about the island?
choices: It was a damp, feverish, unhealthy place
Winter was coming soon and the nights would freeze
A great storm was on the way from the open sea
The treasure was buried somewhere in the marsh
questions.evidence: It was plainly a damp, feverish, unhealthy spot.

questions.q: What did Captain Smollett first suspect about Silver's flag of truce?
choices: That it was a trick
That Silver wanted to surrender
That Silver was badly wounded
That the pirates had found the gold
questions.evidence: Ten to one this is a trick.

questions.q: What title did the pirates now give Silver?
choices: Captain
Quartermaster
Admiral
Boatswain
questions.evidence: These poor lads have chosen me cap'n

questions.q: Silver says the men chose him captain "after your desertion," stressing that word. What does "desertion" mean here?
choices: Leaving the ship and the crew behind
A large, dry area of sand with no water
Winning a hard fight against an enemy
Giving out a sweet treat after dinner
questions.evidence: laying a particular emphasis upon the word "desertion."

questions.q: How did Silver get over the stockade fence?
choices: He threw his crutch over and climbed the fence
The captain unbarred a gate and let him walk in
His companion lifted him up and carried him over
He crawled underneath it through a gap in the logs
questions.evidence: threw over his crutch, got a leg up

questions.q: What did Jim do during the meeting instead of guarding his eastern loophole?
choices: He crept up behind the captain to listen
He lay down and went to sleep
He slipped out the back to find Ben Gunn
He aimed his musket at Silver
questions.evidence: I had already deserted my eastern loophole and crept up behind the captain

questions.q: How was Silver dressed when he came to make terms?
choices: In a huge blue coat with brass buttons and a laced hat
In ragged clothes sewn out of pieces of old sail canvas
In his greasy cook's apron with a ladle at his belt
In a red soldier's uniform taken from the ship's stores
questions.evidence: an immense blue coat, thick with brass buttons

questions.q: Why did the captain make Silver sit outside on the cold sand?
choices: Silver had chosen to be a mutineer instead of an honest man
There was no room left inside for one more man to sit
The doctor was busy treating the wounded men indoors
Silver had a fever and the captain feared he would spread it
questions.evidence: if you had pleased to be an honest man, you might have been sitting in your galley

questions.q: From Silver's talk about a man being attacked in the night, what did Jim guess had happened?
choices: Ben Gunn had visited the drunken pirates and killed one
The doctor had sneaked out in the dark and attacked them
The pirates had fought each other over the last of the rum
A wild goat had charged into their camp and hurt a man
questions.evidence: he had paid the buccaneers a visit while they all lay drunk together round their fire

questions.q: What did Silver demand from the captain?
choices: The chart to find the treasure
The ship's long brass cannon
All of their food
The doctor's medicine chest

questions.q: What did Captain Smollett offer the pirates instead?
choices: To put them in irons and take them home to a fair trial
To give them half of the treasure if they gave up the ship
To carry them free to any port they wanted to be left at
To leave them the ship if they marched out of the stockade
questions.evidence: I'll engage to clap you all in irons and take you home to a fair trial in England

questions.q: Why did the captain say the pirates could not succeed without the loyal party?
choices: None of them could find the treasure or sail the ship
They had no food left at all and would soon starve
Most of their men were already dead or badly wounded
Their ship had run aground and was sinking in the bay
questions.evidence: there's not a man among you fit to sail the ship

questions.q: What happened after Silver asked someone to give him a hand up?
choices: No one moved, so he crawled to the porch and pulled himself up
The captain took his arm and kindly helped him to his feet
Jim ran over and gave him a hand without being asked to
His companion climbed into the stockade and lifted him up
questions.evidence: Not a man among us moved

questions.q: What is the main event of this chapter?
choices: Silver comes to bargain for the chart, is refused, and threatens an attack
Silver comes under a flag of truce to surrender and is put in irons
The captain agrees to trade the treasure map for the ship and safety
Jim sneaks out to listen to the pirates and is taken prisoner by Silver
questions.evidence: Before an hour's out, I'll stove in your old block house like a rum puncheon.
